description: A man in a dark turban and dark suit sits hunched on a wooden bench on a dim railway platform at night, head bowed, with a brown suitcase and a bundled sack beside him. A steam locomotive with smoke and an old wooden-panelled carriage are to the right, and a lit lamp under an ornate canopy lights the station building on the left. Two dark figures stand in the background. Painted in a dark oil style, with no visible text and no frame.
